errors.description: The subject of this option is a 0.15 cm hairline topstitch, and the frame is a wide hip shot in which that stitch spans roughly a pixel. The feature the photograph exists to document is not legible, so the option cannot be compared against its siblings, which differ from it only by stitch distance.
errors.expected: a macro frame in which the stitch reads as an individual line of thread with visible needle penetrations
errors.actual: full-hip framing; the stitch line is essentially invisible
errors.correction: Crop far tighter - the pocket mouth edge should span most of the frame width, with only a few centimetres of cloth either side, so a 0.15 cm stitch offset is measurable against the folded edge. Keep the raking sidelight so each stitch throws a shadow.
